thread_title: S. minor var. okefenokeensis Ware Co, GA clone N
breadcrumb: S. minor var. okefenokeensis Ware Co, GA clone N

posts.body_html:
This clone sometimes has darker red pigment during some years, and in other years, it is this bright green plant with red lips. In any case, it is always shapely.

Below are pictures of S. minor var. okefenokeensis Ware Co, GA clone N:









clone C is in the foreground(the dark red clone in lower right hand corner) and clone N in the background-there's some extreme color differences amongst individuals from this population:



It's also pretty amazing how skinny these traps are-reminds me of those fish that when you look at them head on, they're so skinny you can barely see anything:
